description: This script performs diffing and comparison of source trees in Gerrit repositories, including project and commit statistics, project matching, and exclusion filtering.

methods.name: get_projects
methods.description: Retrieves a dictionary of project names and their absolute paths from a manifest XML file.

methods.name: git
methods.description: Executes a git command with provided arguments and returns its output.

methods.name: get_revision_diff_stats
methods.description: Gets diff statistics between two git revisions in a directory.

methods.name: get_project_stats
methods.description: Retrieves diff stats between upstream and downstream git directories.

methods.name: match_project_by_root_commits
methods.description: Matches a downstream project to an upstream project based on shared root commits.

methods.name: match_projects
methods.description: Matches downstream projects to upstream projects by name or root commit.

methods.name: filter_exclusion_list
methods.description: Filters out projects matching exclusion patterns.

methods.name: get_all_projects_stats
methods.description: Collects stats for all projects in upstream and downstream source trees.

methods.name: stats_from_match
methods.description: Generates diff stats for a specific project match.

methods.name: get_projects_with_filter
methods.description: Retrieves projects applying an exclusion filter.

methods.name: find_root_commits_in_path
methods.description: Finds root commits in a git project path.

methods.name: find_root_commits_in_projects
methods.description: Aggregates root commits across multiple projects.

methods.name: get_commit_stats_in_project
methods.description: Retrieves commits not upstreamed in a project.

methods.name: get_all_commits_stats
methods.description: Collects non-upstreamed commit stats for all projects.

methods.name: write_commit_csv
methods.description: Writes commit statistics to a CSV file.

methods.name: write_project_csv
methods.description: Writes project comparison statistics to a CSV file.

methods.name: diff
methods.description: Performs diffing between upstream and downstream source trees and outputs CSV reports.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Entry point for command-line execution, parsing arguments and invoking diff.
